services.title: Executive Car Hire
services.desc: Chauffeur-driven sedans and SUVs for board meetings, weddings, and city travel — spotless cars, punctual drivers, zero fuss.

services.title: Corporate Transportation
services.desc: One call, one monthly invoice, zero headaches. Fixed corporate tariffs, GST billing and priority cars for your teams and guests.

services.title: Outstation Taxi Services
services.desc: One-way or round trips to Delhi, Chandigarh, Katra, McLeodganj and beyond — drivers who know every highway and every hill route.

services.title: 24/7 Airport Pickup & Drop
services.desc: Sri Guru Ram Dass Jee International (ATQ), any hour. We track your flight, hold a name placard, and wait — the first 30 minutes free.

vehicleOptions: Any vehicle — you decide for me

reasons.title: Economical Rates
reasons.desc: Honest per-kilometre pricing agreed before the wheel turns. No surge nonsense, no meter drama, no surprise line items.

reasons.title: Reasonable Corporate Tariffs
reasons.desc: Fixed monthly packages, GST-compliant invoicing and priority vehicles for businesses that move people every single week.

reasons.title: Professional Chauffeurs
reasons.desc: Uniformed, verified drivers who speak Punjabi, Hindi and English — and know every shortcut from Gol Bagh to the GT Road.

reasons.title: 24/7 Availability
reasons.desc: A 3:40 AM flight? A wedding baraat at midnight? One call and a driver is already warming the engine at the stand.

timeline.title: One taxi, one stand
timeline.text: The first Arora taxi takes its place at the Gol Bagh taxi stand. One car, one promise: reach on time.

timeline.title: The airport runs begin
timeline.text: Word spreads. Regular pickups from Raja Sansi airfield turn into Amritsar's most trusted airport service.

timeline.title: Corporate contracts
timeline.text: Local businesses hand us their guest movement — monthly billing and fixed tariffs are born.

timeline.title: A modern fleet
timeline.text: Every vehicle GPS-tracked, every chauffeur trained and uniformed. The standards go up; the rates stay honest.

timeline.title: 40+ vehicles, one promise
timeline.text: Sedans, SUVs and travellers on call 24×7 — still family-run, still answering the phone at 3 AM.

testimonials.quote: Booked an airport pickup for 3:40 in the morning. The driver was waiting with my name board before I even cleared baggage. That's 27 years of practice.
testimonials.name: Simran Kaur

testimonials.quote: Arora Travels has handled all our guest movement in Amritsar for six years. One call, one invoice, zero headaches. The corporate tariff is genuinely fair.
testimonials.name: Rajesh Malhotra

testimonials.quote: Took the family to Vaishno Devi in their Innova. Spotless car, sure-footed driving on the hills, and a fare exactly as quoted. Our hotel now recommends them too.
testimonials.name: Col. A. S. Gill (Retd.)
